fmodSdk.distribution: FMOD Engine iOS/tvOS SDK (user supplied; never fetched by this repository)
fmodSdk.licensePolicy: The user must obtain and use the SDK under FMOD's applicable licence. No SDK file is tracked.

managedApi.policy: The diagnostic reports and tests the mismatch; neither version is rewritten.

fmodSdl.provenanceEvidence: Both user-owned Celeste Linux bridge binaries embed FMOD_SDL plugin version 190916 and export FMOD_SDL_Register.

linkCompatibility.reason: FMOD 1.10.09 and the accepted Theorafile archive both export six bundled Ogg/Vorbis helper symbols.
linkCompatibility.method: Run Apple nmedit -R on an ignored copy of FMOD's single device object so only the six listed helpers become local, then create a derived deterministic static archive.
linkCompatibility.runtimePolicy: The original SDK archive remains staged and hash-verified; every FMOD_* export remains global; Stage 1 is unchanged.
